summary: Frontend-only E2E verification (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844) of iteration-3 changes: Recipes removal, all remaining routes, new Quality 'Milk Testing' section, new Farmers 'Farm Sourcing' section, Home featured 3D drag rotation, plus regression on products/modal/contact/newsletter/scroll-top. All requested features verified working. Zero console errors on every page tested. Only one real defect found: hover-lift on the new animated cards does not work because framer-motion writes inline transform:none which overrides the Tailwind hover:-translate-y utility.

ui_bugs.issue: hover:-translate-y-2 (and -translate-y-1.5) never applies: framer-motion sets inline style 'opacity: 1; transform: none;' after whileInView finishes, and inline style beats the Tailwind hover class. Verified computed transform stays 'none' before and after hover. Fix by using whileHover={{ y: -8 }} on the motion.div instead of the CSS hover class.
/recipes renders the Home page correctly but the URL stays /recipes (no nav link is active). Consider <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} /> so the URL normalises.

issues: Eyebrow section numbers are arbitrary across pages (MilkTesting = '05' on Quality, FarmSourcing = '09' on Farmers while the journey section below it is '03') - numbering reads inconsistently.

action_items: Replace CSS hover:-translate-y on framer-motion cards in MilkTesting.jsx and FarmSourcing.jsx with whileHover={{ y: -8 }} so the lift actually renders.
Delete dead code left over from the Recipes removal: /app/frontend/src/components/site/Recipes.jsx and RECIPES / RECIPE_FILTERS in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js.
Optional: normalise unknown URLs via <Navigate to='/' replace /> and align Eyebrow section numbering.
critical_code_review_comments: FeaturedSlider: inline transform + manual pointer handlers work well; note onPointerLeave={onPointerUp} could end a drag prematurely on small containers - consider relying only on pointer capture / pointerup+pointercancel.
Recipes.jsx and RECIPES data are now unreachable dead code (still bundled).

Welcome to VITA.'. Loader dismisses reliably after ~4s wait + a mouse move.
rca_of_the_issue: Hover lift failure RCA: framer-motion's whileInView animation ends by writing inline style 'transform: none' on the element. Tailwind's hover:-translate-y-2 only sets CSS custom props/transform via a class, which has lower specificity than the inline style, so the hover transform is never applied (computed transform stays 'none' on hover).
